title: 第1章 高三开学
content_zh:
九月的阳光，依旧炽热，那火辣辣的日头照的大街上的人们都行色匆匆，汗流浃背，不想在外面多待上一秒钟。

可是，对于季枫来说，这个季节却比冬天还要寒冷！

“慧慧，你，你刚才说什么？”季枫颤声问道。

“我说，我要和你分手！”名叫慧慧的女孩冷漠的说道，“还有，从今以后，请不要叫我慧慧，我的名字叫做胡雪慧！”

“为什么？”季枫脸色灰白的问道，“慧慧，这是为什么？”

季枫的心一阵绞痛，几乎就要栽倒。

就在两个月前，两人还曾经海誓山盟，说好永不分开，可是，一个暑假过去，他竟然听到了分手的决绝话语，这让他如何心甘？

季枫呆呆的望着面前这个美丽的女孩，心中疼痛难忍。

胡雪慧与季枫同时邙石县二中的高三年级学生，而且是同班同学。

季枫为人实在，话也不多，虽然家在县城，但是却没有其他那些县城的学生的张扬，只是成绩稍微差了一点，在班里也只能算是中等偏下。

而胡雪慧性格活泼，人长得又漂亮，喜欢与人交谈，又是班里的副班长，所以深得男同学的喜欢，有几个男同学甚至为了她而打架。

但是最终，还是一向寡言少语的季枫得到了女孩的芳心。

因为两人是同桌，所以时间长了，彼此互相产生了好感，暗暗发展起了地下恋情。

然而，季枫却没有想到，高三刚一开学，他就听到了胡雪慧分手的要求。

“为什么？你还好意思问我为什么？”胡雪慧一听这话，声音不由提高了不少，让周围来回路过的学生不禁转头看过来扫上几眼。

“我做错什么了吗？”季枫脸色苍白的问道，语气中几乎带上了哀求的意味。

“季枫，我们是不可能继续下去的，因为我们未来的路不同！”胡雪慧冷漠而高傲的说道：“你认为以你的家庭条件，可以支持你去上大学吗？以你的成绩，能考上大学吗？我可是要上大学的，以后还会去城市里生活，跟你在一起，只会毁了我的前途！”

“家庭？”季枫的脸色顿时变得苍白无比，还是不死心的问道，“我不是早就跟你说过，我的家里很穷，你为什么到现在才提出分手？”

“为什么？”胡雪慧冷笑一声，语气中充满了嘲讽，“季枫，你知道吗，暑假里我去了江州的姐姐家里，你知道姐姐和姐夫住的房子值多少钱吗？你就是努力一辈子，连一个厕所也买不起，你知道我姐姐开的车值多少钱吗？”

季枫艰难的摇头，说道：“我会努力挣钱的！”

季枫听胡雪慧说起过她的姐姐，据说她的姐姐在江州打工，怎么现在突然变成有钱人了？

“哼，努力？”胡雪慧嘲讽的笑道：“努力多少年？十年，二十年？还是五十年？我可不想跟着你到了快要老死的时候，才能在大城市里买得起房子，才能开上车，季枫，以后你不要再纠缠我了，我可是一定要到江州去上大学的，到时候，我们就不是同一个世界的人了！”

季枫愣愣的盯着她，原本那张俏脸，是会时刻对他绽放最美丽的笑容的，可是现在，这张美丽的脸上，写满了高傲，那双动人的眸子里，充满了冷漠。

“好，我们分手！”季枫终于点了点头。胡雪慧已经表现出拒人千里之外的冷漠，他的努力挽回，也只是徒劳的。

在这种情况下，内心自卑的季枫，选择了为自己保留最后一点尊严！

“还有，位子我已经找老师调过了，以后我们也不再是同桌，也没有任何关系了！”胡雪慧冷漠的说了一句，就高傲的转身离开，连看都不再看季枫一眼。

一直在不远处等候着胡雪慧的一位女生，见二人的谈话已经结束，便走过去陪着她逐渐离开。

“雪慧，你刚才的话似乎太重了，这样不太好吧？”远远的，传来了那个女生的声音。

“哼，我这样说算是客气的了！”胡雪慧显得很是愤怒，“亏得他还是城里人，家里竟然那么穷，平时连一件礼物都不舍得给我买，我以前真是瞎了眼，怎么会看上他？！”

“雪慧，你小声一些，不要被季枫听到了！”那女生似乎觉得有些不好，劝阻道。

“听到怕什么？一个穷鬼私生子而已……”胡雪慧不屑的说道。

不远处的季枫听到这句话，瞬间仿佛被炸雷击中一般，整个人呆立当场，急促的呼吸着，脸涨得通红，眼中几乎要喷出火来。

季枫的牙都要咬碎了，额头上的青筋高高的冒起，整个人几乎窒息，他的拳头攥紧，松开，再攥紧，再松开……

直到胡雪慧和那个女生走远，季枫才终于勉强平静下来，凄然的一笑：“私生子……野种……呵呵……”

没错，季枫是一个私生子，说的难听一些，就是一个野种！

这个秘密，除了胡雪慧之外，他从来没有对任何人讲过。就因为季枫是私生子，他的母亲被外公外婆赶出了家门，如果不是好心人的接济，他们母子早已经变成了街头的乞丐，甚至是饿死街头。

私生子这三个字，成了小时候别的孩子嘲笑他的最好的笑料，伴随着他的整个童年。

就因为私生子的身份，季枫才变得自卑，内向，哪怕别人一个嘲讽的眼神，都能让他羞愧欲死。

直到遇到了胡雪慧，季枫的性格才算开朗了一些。也因为这样，他才把自己的家庭与身份都告诉了胡雪慧。

但是他却怎么也想不到，自己的穷苦家庭，成了胡雪慧提出分手的理由，而自己私生子的身份，却成了她嘲笑与不屑的对象！

季枫摇了摇头，失魂落魄的朝着学校外走去，凄然的笑着：“私生子，我只是一个任人耻笑的私生子罢了，连我最爱的人，都肆无忌惮的嘲讽我……”

炎热的九月，街上几乎见不到行人，让季枫更显得孤独。唯有旁边店铺里的电视在播放着音乐与电视节目，使得这个夏季不那么孤寂。

“最新播报，科学家日前在距离太阳系十亿光年的外太空，观察到一团蟹状星云，其中释放出令人惊讶的伽马射线耀斑，这是迄今为止在宇宙星云中首次观测到伽马射线耀斑。根据科学家推测，伽马射线耀斑因为距离太过遥远，所以不会对人类的生活产生影响……”

正在播放这组新闻的播音员并不知道，就在大气层外，一束伽马射线耀斑正朝着地球激射而来。

季枫失魂落魄的走在大街上，漫无目的，被心爱的女孩恶毒的讥讽，让他心碎若死，仿佛没有了灵魂。

就在这时，天空中的阳光似乎闪烁了一下，一束肉眼难见的光束，击中了季枫的头部，让他当场晕倒在地，失去了知觉。
content_en:
The September sun was still blazing, and people on the streets illuminated by the scorching sun were in a hurry, sweating profusely, and didn't want to stay outside for one more second.

However, for Ji Feng, this season is colder than winter!

"Huihui, you, what did you just say?" Ji Feng asked in a trembling voice.

"I said, I want to break up with you!" the girl named Huihui said coldly, "Also, from now on, please don't call me Huihui, my name is Hu Xuehui!"

"Why?" Ji Feng asked with a pale face, "Huihui, why is this?"

Ji Feng's heart ached and he almost fell down.

Just two months ago, the two of them had promised each other that they would never separate. However, after a summer vacation, he actually heard the decisive words of breaking up. How could he be willing to do so?

Ji Feng stared blankly at the beautiful girl in front of him, feeling unbearable pain in his heart.

Hu Xuehui and Ji Feng are both senior students in Manshi County No. 2 Middle School and are classmates.

Ji Feng is a down-to-earth person and doesn't talk much. Although his family is in the county town, he is not as flamboyant as other students in the county town. However, his grades are slightly worse and he can only be considered below average in the class.

Hu Xuehui has a lively personality, is beautiful, likes to talk to others, and is the deputy monitor of the class, so she is deeply loved by her male classmates. Some male classmates even fight for her.

But in the end, Ji Feng, who has always been taciturn, won the girl's heart.

Because the two were at the same table, over time, they developed a good impression of each other and secretly developed an underground love affair.

However, Ji Feng did not expect that as soon as the third year of high school started, he would hear Hu Xuehui's request to break up.

"Why? You have the nerve to ask me why?" Upon hearing this, Hu Xuehui's voice couldn't help but raise a lot, causing the students passing back and forth to turn around and glance at her.

"Did I do something wrong?" Ji Feng asked with a pale face, almost pleading in his tone.

"Ji Feng, it's impossible for us to continue because our future paths are different!" Hu Xuehui said coldly and arrogantly: "Do you think that your family's conditions can support you to go to college? With your grades, can you be admitted to college? I want to go to college, and I will live in the city in the future. Being with you will only ruin my future!"

"Family?" Ji Feng's face suddenly turned extremely pale, but he still asked without giving up, "Didn't I tell you earlier that my family is very poor, why did you just break up now?"

"Why?" Hu Xuehui sneered, her tone full of ridicule, "Ji Feng, do you know, I went to my sister's house in Jiangzhou during the summer vacation. Do you know how much the house where my sister and brother-in-law live is worth? You have worked hard all your life and can't even afford a toilet. Do you know how much the car my sister drives is worth?"

Ji Feng shook his head hard and said, "I will work hard to make money!"

Ji Feng heard Hu Xuehui talk about her sister. It was said that her sister was working in Jiangzhou. Why did she suddenly become a rich person now?

"Humph, work hard?" Hu Xuehui laughed sarcastically: "How many years of hard work? Ten years, twenty years? Or fifty years? I don't want to follow you until you are about to die of old age, so that you can afford to buy a house in a big city and drive a car. Ji Feng, don't pester me anymore. I must go to Jiangzhou to go to college. By then, we will no longer be in the same world!"

Ji Feng stared at her blankly, her pretty face would always smile at him with the most beautiful smile, but now, this beautiful face was filled with arrogance, and those moving eyes were filled with indifference.

"Okay, let's break up!" Ji Feng finally nodded.Hu Xuehui has already shown her indifference to others, and his efforts to save her are in vain.

In this situation, Ji Feng, who felt inferior in his heart, chose to preserve the last bit of dignity for himself!

"Also, I have asked the teacher to change my seat. From now on, we will no longer be at the same table and have nothing to do with each other!" Hu Xuehui said coldly, then turned around and left proudly, not even looking at Ji Feng.

A girl who had been waiting for Hu Xuehui not far away saw that the conversation between the two had ended, so she walked over and gradually left with her.

"Xue Hui, what you just said seemed too strong. Isn't that bad?" The girl's voice came from far away.

"Hmph, I'm being polite when I say that!" Hu Xuehui looked very angry, "Thankfully, he is still from the city, but his family is so poor, and he is usually reluctant to buy me a gift. I was really blind before, how could I fall in love with him?!"

"Xue Hui, please keep your voice down, don't let Ji Feng hear you!" The girl seemed to feel something was wrong and tried to dissuade her.

"What are you afraid of? He's just a poor bastard..." Hu Xuehui said disdainfully.

When Ji Feng, who was not far away, heard these words, he felt as if he had been struck by lightning. He stood stunned on the spot, breathing rapidly, his face turned red, and his eyes almost burst out of fire.

Ji Feng's teeth were about to be broken, and the veins on his forehead were rising high. He was almost suffocating. His fists were clenched, loosened, clenched again, and then loosened...

It wasn't until Hu Xuehui and the girl walked away that Ji Feng finally managed to calm down and smiled sadly: "Illegitimate son...bastard...haha..."

That's right, Ji Feng is an illegitimate child. To put it harshly, he is a bastard!

Except for Hu Xuehui, he had never told anyone this secret.Just because Ji Feng was an illegitimate child, his mother was kicked out of the house by his grandparents. If it weren't for the help from kind people, their mother and son would have become beggars on the streets, or even starved to death on the streets.

The word "illegitimate child" became the best joke that other children used to laugh at him when he was a child, and it stayed with him throughout his childhood.

Just because of his status as an illegitimate child, Ji Feng became inferior and introverted. Even a mocking look from others could make him die of shame.

It wasn't until he met Hu Xuehui that Ji Feng's personality became more cheerful.Because of this, he told Hu Xuehui his family and identity.

But he never imagined that his poor family would become Hu Xuehui's reason for breaking up, and that his identity as an illegitimate child would become the object of her ridicule and disdain!

Ji Feng shook his head and walked out of the school in despair, smiling sadly: "Illegitimate son, I am just an illegitimate son who can be ridiculed. Even the people I love most are mocking me unscrupulously..."

On a hot September day, there were almost no pedestrians on the street, making Ji Feng even more lonely.Only the TV in the nearby store was playing music and TV programs, making this summer less lonely.

"The latest report is that scientists recently observed a Crab Nebula in outer space one billion light years away from the solar system, which released a surprising gamma ray flare. This is the first time a gamma ray flare has been observed in a cosmic nebula so far. According to scientists' speculation, gamma ray flares are too far away to have an impact on human life..."

The announcer who was broadcasting this set of news did not know that just outside the atmosphere, a beam of gamma ray flares was shooting towards the earth.

Ji Feng walked on the street in despair, aimlessly, and was viciously ridiculed by the girl he loved, which made him heartbroken, as if he had no soul.

At this moment, the sunlight in the sky seemed to flicker, and a beam of light invisible to the naked eye hit Ji Feng's head, causing him to faint and lose consciousness on the spot.
